ownership_reason: Only the gold chooses the renderer that creates the legend items of a dataset: hop 1 creates and returns the collection, hop 2 visits the dataset indices in order, hop 3 reads the dataset at the index and skips an index with none, hop 4 passes the values along; no other hop sees a renderer. With the fallback dropped, a dataset whose index has no renderer of its own adds no items, although the plot draws it with its primary renderer, so the gold's contract (the legend items for the series of the dataset) is violated on the trigger input. The convention is pinned outside the gold: XYPlot.getRendererForDataset (the renderer with the same index, or renderer 0 if there is none) and XYPlot.render (getRenderer(index), or getRenderer() if that is null) do the same step in production; XYPlotTests::testGetRendererForDataset (a dataset without a renderer maps to renderer 0) and XYLineAndShapeRendererTests::testGetLegendItemSeriesIndex (the primary renderer creates the item for a series of dataset 1, which has no renderer of its own) pass.
